## Introduction

This analysis examines water quality at 10 stream sites sampled monthly from January-December 2023.

We measured:

-   pH
-   Dissolved oxygen (mg/L)
-   Nitrate concentration (mg/L)

Our goal is to identify sites exceeding EPA standards.

## Load Data

```{r}
#| label: load-data-water
#| message: false

library(readr)

# Load water quality data
water <- read_csv(".../data/raw/water_samples.csv")

# Quick look
head(water)
```

## Summary Statistics

```{r}
#| label: calculate-means

mean_ph <- mean(water$pH, na.rm = TRUE)
mean_do <- mean(water$dissolved_oxygen, na.rm = TRUE)
```

The mean pH across all sites was `r round(mean_ph, 2)`. Mean dissolved oxygen was `r round(mean_do, 1)` mg/L.
